revisions.claim: Three collector addresses are the same addresses indexed as Heurist Inference Router, AskSurf and Heurist Mesh in the XRPL x402 merchant index.
revisions.verification: Exact string match of all three XRPL account addresses across the Bitquery investigation and XRP Insights x402 merchant listing.

revisions.claim: XRPL Checks batch settlement entered closed beta on mainnet October 14; 213,008 paid requests were handled in 3,162 sessions and 6,324 ledger transactions from October 14–17.
revisions.verification: Official t54 Labs product update. It does not identify the 110-wallet cohort as a beta participant.

revisions.claim: Coinbase contributed x402; Coinbase, Circle, Ripple, Mastercard and t54 Labs are among the x402 Foundation members. Circle publicly discusses USDC; Ripple publicly discusses XRP and RLUSD on XRPL.
revisions.verification: Linux Foundation primary announcement; establishes shared open-standard participation, not exclusivity.

correction: The earlier 'dust bot' wording remains a description of automated small-value payments, but does not establish spam, manipulation, or illegality. Reclassify as x402-compatible agent micropayments with unknown operator and unknown production/test status.
